gaps.title: Safe zones swallow a finished step counter: 182 s of walking, one fight
gaps.detail: Measured in /index.html, no cheats. Held the arrow keys and walked Puddlewick Vale continuously for 182.4 s: exactly ONE encounter fired, at 31.4 s. At the end of that walk state().encounter read paces 73.4, threshold 57, stepsToNext 0, grace 0, inSafeZone true, battlesOnMap 2. So the counter had been finished and pegged at zero for over a minute and the fight was being suppressed indefinitely because the player was inside one of the meadow's four safeZones - which cover the ground around the spawn point, exactly where a child wanders first. A separate clean run measured 25.1 s of unbroken walking before the very first fight (grace 80 paces on arrival plus a 22-62 pace threshold = 102-142 paces before anything ever happens). DQV PS2 gives you a fight every 15-40 s on the overworld and a safe patch is a town doorstep, not a field. BUILD: shrink safe zones to door aprons and shop/inn thresholds only, so the walkable meadow is never covered; when stepsToNext hits 0 inside a safe zone, arm the encounter and fire it on the first pace outside instead of re-rolling or idling; cut the arrival grace from 80 paces to about 25 so the first fight of a session finds a child inside ten seconds. Expose stepsToNext<=0 && inSafeZone in state() as a named 'held' reason so it can be verified by measurement next round.

events.note: src/world/encounter.js: SAFE_RADIUS 12 -> 5 (a door apron round an exit / church / save point) and 4 round the spawn point, so the walkable meadow is never covered; arrival grace 80 -> 26 paces; escalation capped at +18 instead of +30 and max clamped to mode+10 (min and mode used to climb PAST max, which made the triangular draw degenerate after five fights on one map). state() now names the reason nothing is happening: safeRadius, armed, and held ('grace' | 'armed: waiting to leave the doorstep' | 'firing' | 'no encounters here' | 'busy') — the arm-and-fire rule (finish the counter inside an apron and the fight goes off on the first pace outside) is now observable instead of invisible. Measured in /index.html with no cheats, holding the arrow keys: first fight of a session at 13.2s and again at 14.5s of walking (critic measured 25.1s); two fights in 90s of continuous walking, ending grace 4, inSafeZone false, held null, armed false (critic measured ONE fight in 182.4s, ending paces 73.4 / threshold 57 / stepsToNext 0 / grace 0 / inSafeZone true — pegged for over a minute). scenarios/P15.json asserts grace 20..30 and safeRadius <= 6; scenarios/P15-index.json asserts the counter is never left armed inside an apron. Both exit 0.
SAFE_RADIUS=5; counter arms in safe and fires on first pace out. shots/P31-probe: grace drains, paces climb to threshold, armed in safe, fight on leaving (fight:true).

gaps.title: areas.js kits three people in Gleaming Plate at leg 10, and the wild gold does not match the new leg payouts
gaps.detail: Two numbers in tests/battle/areas.js and tests/battle/data.js do not add up against the shop. (1) Under a household hand-me-down model (Economy.audit in src/data/shops.js: a piece somebody has outgrown is passed down free, only what nobody will wear again is handed over at 75 percent) the assumed parties cost 34,978 G of fresh kit, and 17,900 G of that lands in leg 10 alone because quiet_deep puts three characters in Gleaming Plate at 3,200 G each plus Thunderfork and Dragon-scale Shield. P22 has raised the SYSTEMS section 5 leg payouts to cover it (battle gold 16,968 to 24,000, chest gold 6,955 to 13,140, every leg now ends with 37 to 500 percent slack, 9,543 G left at the end) but the honest fix is that a family shares one best set, not three. (2) Those payouts are only a plan until the per-species gold in tests/battle/data.js and balance-wild.js averages the leg gold column: 6, 12, 22, 36, 56, 90, 160, 240, 360, 500 G per fight, with the per-fight spread from goldBand(leg) in src/data/shops.js (plus or minus 30 percent).

events.note: Family shares one Gleaming Plate (hero only) at Quiet Deep / Whistfell; Rowan+Barty wear iron_armour. Economy.audit leg10 kit 17900→11500; shortfallNet 0
